title: Pharmacokinetic Drug Interactions in Solid Organ Transplantation: From Molecular Mechanisms and Formulation Science to Therapeutic Drug Monitoring and Precision Dosing.
snippet: Solid organ transplant (SOT) recipients are especially vulnerable to pharmacokinetic drug interactions because narrow-therapeutic-index immunosuppressants are used in the setting of polypharmacy, rapidly changing physiology, variable gastrointestinal function, and frequent anti-infective therapy. title: Beyond Structural Classification: A 4S+G Functional Framework for Non-Coding RNA Biology in Cancer and Its Therapeutic Implications.
snippet: Non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) regulate gene expression at multiple levels in cancer, yet their functional plasticity and the slow pace of clinical translation remain incompletely explained.
